responsibility: Declares the exported helper interface shared with the _BitInt lowering implementation for SSA conflict construction. In particular it publishes build_bitint_stmt_ssa_conflicts, which lets other SSA/live-range code compute conflicts for GIMPLE statements involving lowered _BitInt temporaries using live_track and ssa_conflicts callbacks, without exposing the rest of gimple-lower-bitint.cc internals.
same_name_distinction: This header is the narrow public interface of the _BitInt lowering pair: it declares only the exported SSA-conflict helper build_bitint_stmt_ssa_conflicts for other code, while gcc/gimple-lower-bitint.cc contains the lowering machinery and pass implementations themselves.
